benchmarks/2026-10-24/corpus-qualificati:
name: Qualify real PGN corpus without artifacts
on:
  push:
    branches: ['perf/qt-corpus-qualification']
    paths: ['.github/workflows/corpus-qualification.yml', 'scripts/qualify-real-corpus.py']
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: trait64-corpus-qualification
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  real-corpus:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Reserve disk on the disposable GitHub runner
        shell: bash
        run: |
          test "${RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT:-}" = github-hosted
          df -h "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          # These preinstalled SDKs are not dependencies of this C++/Qt job.
          # Never target the repository, user data, releases or Actions storage.
          sudo rm -rf -- /usr/share/dotnet /usr/local/lib/android
          df -h "$RUNNER_TEMP"
      - name: Install build and corpus dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends cmake ninja-build libarchive-dev libsqlite3-dev qt6-base-dev qt6-declarative-dev qml6-module-qtqml qml6-module-qtqml-models qml6-module-qtqml-workerscript qml6-module-qtquick qml6-module-qtquick-controls qml6-module-qtquick-layouts qml6-module-qtquick-dialogs qml6-module-qtquick-templates qml6-module-qtquick-window libqt6sql6-sqlite libqt6svg6 fonts-dejavu-core zstd
      - name: Build the two real-corpus probes
        run: |
          cmake -S . -B build-perf -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DT64_BENCHMARKS=ON
          cmake --build build-perf --target pgn_benchmark desktop_tests --parallel 2
      - name: Fetch the pinned CC0 corpus
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/trait64-corpus"
          curl --fail --location --retry 2 --max-time 300 --max-filesize 30000000 https://database.lichess.org/standard/lichess_db_standard_rated_2013-01.pgn.zst -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/trait64-corpus/source.pgn.zst"
          zstd -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/trait64-corpus/source.pgn.zst" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/trait64-corpus/source.pgn"
      - name: Measure Qt, reindexing, import and restoration
        env:
          QT_QPA_PLATFORM: offscreen
          QT_QUICK_BACKEND: software
        run: python3 scripts/qualify-real-corpus.py --input "$RUNNER_TEMP/trait64-corpus/source.pgn" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/trait64-measures"
